<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { DM_Serif_Display, Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./handoff/handoff.css";
const display = DM_Serif_Display({ subsets: ["latin"], weight: "400", variable: "--font-handoff-display" });
const body = Geist({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-handoff-body" });
const mono = Geist_Mono({ subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-handoff-mono" });
export const metadata: Metadata = { metadataBase: new URL("https://openlandingpage.vercel.app"), title: "HANDOFF — Good work, routed well.", description: "A conversion landing page for small businesses that need reliable operators.", icons: { icon: "/templates/handoff/icon.svg" } };
export default function HandoffLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) { return <html lang="en" className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable} overflow-x-clip`}><body className="handoff-body overflow-x-clip"><noscript><style>{`[data-hf-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}`}</style></noscript>{children}</body></html>; }


]]>

<![CDATA[export type IntakeValues = { name: string; email: string; goal: string };
export type IntakeErrors = Partial<Record<keyof IntakeValues,string>>;
export function validateIntake(values: IntakeValues): IntakeErrors { const errors:IntakeErrors={}; if(!values.name.trim()) errors.name="Add your name."; if(!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(values.email.trim())) errors.email="Enter a work email."; if(!values.goal) errors.goal="Choose a service lane."; return errors; }
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";
import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";
import { validateIntake, type IntakeValues } from "./intake";
const goals = [["sales","Follow-up + sales ops"],["content","Web + content"],["admin","Admin + delivery"]] as const;
export function IntakeForm({ compact=false }: { compact?: boolean }) { const [values,setValues]=useState<IntakeValues>({name:"",email:"",goal:""}); const [errors,setErrors]=useState<ReturnType<typeof validateIntake>>({}); const [status,setStatus]=useState<"idle"|"error"|"success">("idle"); const update=(key:keyof IntakeValues,value:string)=>{setValues(v=>({...v,[key]:value}));setErrors(e=>({...e,[key]:undefined}));setStatus("idle")}; const submit=(e:FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>)=>{e.preventDefault();const next=validateIntake(values);setErrors(next);if(Object.keys(next).length){setStatus("error");return;}setStatus("success")}; return <form data-status={status} className={`hf-form${compact?" hf-form--compact":""}`} onSubmit={submit} noValidate>{status==="success"?<div className="hf-success"><span className="hf-success-mark">✓</span><h3>Brief received.</h3><p>We’ll route it within two business days. Nothing was sent; this template has no endpoint yet.</p><a href="#top" className="hf-button hf-button--light">Back to the top ↗</a></div>:<><fieldset><legend>What should we route?</legend><div className="hf-goals">{goals.map(([value,label])=><span key={value}><input id={`hf-${value}-${compact?"c":"f"}`} type="radio" name="goal" value={value} checked={values.goal===value} onChange={e=>update("goal",e.target.value)} /><label htmlFor={`hf-${value}-${compact?"c":"f"}`}>{label}</label></span>)}</div><small className="hf-error">{errors.goal??"Choose the lane that needs a little more room."}</small></fieldset><div className="hf-fields"><label>Name<input name="name" autoComplete="name" value={values.name} onChange={e=>update("name",e.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} /> <small>{errors.name??""}</small></label><label>Work email<input name="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" value={values.email} onChange={e=>update("email",e.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} /> <small>{errors.email??""}</small></label></div><button className="hf-button hf-button--orange" type="submit">Send the brief <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button><p className="hf-form-status" aria-live="polite">{status==="error"?"One detail still needs your attention.":"Short form · clear reply · no commitment"}</p></>}</form>; }

]]>

<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect } from "react";
export function PointerMotion(){useEffect(()=>{if(!window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)return;const cleanup:Array<()=>void>=[];const bind=(node:HTMLElement,kind:"art"|"button"|"card")=>{const move=(event:PointerEvent)=>{const rect=node.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(event.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width-.5;const y=(event.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height-.5;if(kind==="art"){node.style.setProperty("--hf-px",String(x*16)+"px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-py",String(y*12)+"px")}else if(kind==="button"){node.style.setProperty("--hf-mx",String(x*5)+"px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-my",String(y*4)+"px")}else{node.style.setProperty("--hf-tilt-x",String(y*-3)+"deg");node.style.setProperty("--hf-tilt-y",String(x*4)+"deg")}};const leave=()=>{node.style.setProperty("--hf-px","0px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-py","0px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-mx","0px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-my","0px");node.style.setProperty("--hf-tilt-x","0deg");node.style.setProperty("--hf-tilt-y","0deg")};node.addEventListener("pointermove",move);node.addEventListener("pointerleave",leave);cleanup.push(()=>{node.removeEventListener("pointermove",move);node.removeEventListener("pointerleave",leave)})};const art=document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".hf-hero-art");if(art)bind(art,"art");document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".hf-button").forEach(n=>bind(n,"button"));document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".hf-lane-card,.hf-gap-cards article,.hf-proof-grid article").forEach(n=>bind(n,"card"));return()=>cleanup.forEach(fn=>fn)},[]);return null}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(handoff)/handoff/motion/Reveals.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect } from "react";
export function Reveals(){useEffect(()=>{document.documentElement.classList.add("has-js");const nodes=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-hf-reveal]"));if(window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches){nodes.forEach(n=>n.dataset.hfIn="true");return()=>document.documentElement.classList.remove("has-js")};const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){(entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.hfIn="true";observer.unobserve(entry.target)}}),{rootMargin:"0px 0px -12% 0px",threshold:.12});nodes.forEach(n=>observer.observe(n));return()=>{observer.disconnect();document.documentElement.classList.remove("has-js")}},[]);return null}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect } from "react";
export function ScrollVars(){useEffect(()=>{let frame=0;const update=()=>{frame=0;const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hf-progress",String(max>0?window.scrollY/max:0))};const onScroll=()=>{if(!frame)frame=requestAnimationFrame(update)};update();window.addEventListener("scroll",onScroll,{passive:true});window.addEventListener("resize",onScroll);return()=>{window.removeEventListener("scroll",onScroll);window.removeEventListener("resize",onScroll);if(frame)cancelAnimationFrame(frame)}},[]);return null}
]]>

const stages = [["01","INQUIRY","A real brief lands."],["02","QUALIFIED","Fit, scope and timing are clear."],["03","MATCHED","An operator takes the thread."],["04","MANAGED","The work keeps moving."],["05","DONE","You get the outcome, not another task."]] as const;
export function Pipeline(){const ref=useRef<HTMLElement>(null);const [active,setActive]=useState(0);useEffect(()=>{const node=ref.current;if(!node)return;const observer=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>entries.forEach((entry)=>{if(entry.isIntersecting)setActive(Number((entry.target as HTMLElement).dataset.stage??0));}),{rootMargin:"-40% 0px -40% 0px",threshold:0});const cards=Array.from(node.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-stage]"));cards.forEach((card)=>observer.observe(card));return()=>observer.disconnect();},[]);return <section className="hf-pipeline" id="pipeline" ref={ref}><div className="hf-container hf-pipeline-grid"><div className="hf-pipeline-intro"><p className="hf-eyebrow">02 / THE ROUTE</p><h2>Every brief deserves a <em>clear lane.</em></h2><p>Scroll the route. Your brief becomes a ticket, picks up a fit signal, and reaches the operator who can keep it moving.</p><div className="hf-pipeline-status"><span className="hf-status-dot"/> LIVE ROUTING <b>{"0"+(active+1)+" / 05"}</b></div></div><div className="hf-pipeline-stage"><div className="hf-pipeline-rail" style={{"--hf-route-progress":String(active/4*100)+"%"} as CSSProperties}><span className="hf-pipeline-fill"/></div>{stages.map(([number,title,copy],index)=><article key={title} className={"hf-stage "+(active===index?"is-active ":"")+(active>index?"is-past":"")} data-stage={index}><div className="hf-stage-marker">{number}</div><div><span className="hf-stage-label">{title}</span><h3>{copy}</h3><p>{index===0?"Tell us the kind of work your team can take on.":index===1?"We make the scope and timing legible.":index===2?"A HANDOFF operator becomes the point person.":index===3?"Updates, follow-ups and loose ends stay owned.":"The result arrives with the next opportunity already visible."}</p></div>{active===index&&<div className="hf-ticket"><span>HANDOFF TICKET</span><b>{title}</b><small>status: moving →</small></div>}</article>)}</div></div></section>}

data-hf-reveal="mask">Good leads do not disappear. They <em>get stuck.</em></h2><p class="hf-gap-copy" data-hf-reveal="rise">A full inbox is not the same as a manageable pipeline. We help you choose the work that fits your week, your margin, and the way your team actually operates.</p><div class="hf-gap-cards"><article data-hf-reveal="settle"><span>01</span><strong>Too many maybes</strong><p>Interest arrives without a clear next step, so every enquiry costs more attention than it should.</p></article><article data-hf-reveal="settle"><span>02</span><strong>No owner on the route</strong><p>The work is worth doing, but nobody has the spare hours to keep it warm and moving.</p></article><article data-hf-reveal="settle"><span>03</span><strong>Good work, badly timed</strong><p>The right client shows up on the wrong week. We route it to a capacity window you can keep.</p></article></div></div></section><section class="hf-pipeline" id="pipeline"><div class="hf-container hf-pipeline-grid"><div class="hf-pipeline-intro"><p class="hf-eyebrow">02 / THE ROUTE</p><h2>Every brief deserves a <em>clear lane.</em></h2><p>Scroll the route.
